{{Quote|But you didn't see us alone in the south passage. She expressed her true feelings for me.|Han Solo to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ESB" />}}
The '''south passage''' was a corridor located with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. After [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] announced his intention to leave Echo Base due to the [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] placed upon his head, the south passage was the site of an argument between him and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Organa believed that Solo had decided to stay with the Alliance, but Solo was of the opinion that Organa wanted him to stay due to her having feelings for him.<ref name="ESB" />
